items.title: Hackers Exploit PHP2Shell Flaws in Check Point Gateways to Deploy TSGA Backdoor and Wipe ESXi Files
items.snippet: An unknown threat actor has been observed targeting unpatched Check Point Security Gateways to obtain initial access via the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities and then a previously reported local privilege escalation flaw in Gaia OS to deploy a backdoor called TSGA. The activity, detailed by Check Point, began on October 30, 2026, and targeted Israeli organizations, with a broader follow-up wave
items.summary: Threat actors are exploiting PHP2Shell vulnerabilities in unpatched Check Point Security Gateways to deploy backdoors and wipe files. Organizations using Check Point gateways are affected. Upgrade Check Point Security Gateways to the latest patched version or apply mitigations.

That kind of scenario raises a response question: what does “stop the agent” actually mean? A

items.title: New Mior and Skyfall Attacks Let Rogue Cloud Hosts Steal Secrets From AMD SEV-SNP VMs
items.snippet: Two attacks made public this week allow a malicious host to read data inside AMD SEV-SNP-protected virtual machines (VMs), which are built to keep the server's operator out. One of them, Mior, can also modify a VM's memory and fake the signed report confirming which software it runs. Both need control of the server's hypervisor, and Mior also needs control of the server's BIOS. Researchers
items.summary: Mior and Skyfall attacks let rogue cloud hosts steal secrets or modify memory in AMD SEV-SNP virtual machines. Cloud infrastructure users running confidential VMs should review host trust configurations. No fix yet: watch for a patch.

items.snippet: `TraceContextTextMapPropagator.extract()` in `opentelemetry-api` is vulnerable to regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) when processing a specially crafted `traceparent` value. A malformed value containing a trace-context prefix followed by a long whitespace sequence and an embedded newline triggers quadratic-time regex backtracking. Applications that extract trace context from untrusted c…
items.summary: OpenTelemetry Python API is vulnerable to ReDoS via crafted traceparent values during extraction. Python developers using opentelemetry-api are affected. Upgrade opentelemetry-api to 1.45.2 or later.

items.title: Soup Sieve: Exponential ReDoS in selector compilation via \9-run in CSS_ESCAPES/IDENTIFIER
items.snippet: The IDENTIFIER/CSS_ESCAPES regex (css_parser.py:119-124) exhibits exponential backtracking on a run of ambiguous digit-escapes (`\9`) in an attribute-name or tag position of an otherwise well-formed selector. It fires at compile time (before the SELECTOR_LIMIT guard) via the public `soupsieve.compile()` and BeautifulSoup `.select()`. import soupsieve as sv sv.compile('[a' + '\\9'*26 + '=x]') # ~5…
items.summary: Soup Sieve suffers from exponential backtracking ReDoS in CSS selector compilation. Python developers using BeautifulSoup or soupsieve are affected. Upgrade soupsieve to 3.0.2 or later.

items.title: Soup Sieve: Uncontrolled recursion in CSS parser lets nested pseudo-class selectors exhaust the Python call stack
items.snippet: The Soup Sieve CSS selector parser recurses once per level of nested pseudo-class selector (`:is()`, `:not()`, `:where()`, `:has()`) without any limit on nesting depth. An unauthenticated attacker who can supply a CSS selector string to `soupsieve.compile()`, `soupsieve.select()`, or Beautiful Soup's `soup.select()` / `soup.select_one()` can force the parser to exceed Python's recursion limit wit…
items.summary: Soup Sieve allows uncontrolled recursion during CSS selector parsing via nested pseudo-classes. Python developers parsing untrusted CSS selectors with soupsieve are affected. Upgrade soupsieve to 3.0.2 or later.

items.snippet: When a dynamic tag (`const Tag =...; `) resolves to a string, Astro renders it as a raw HTML element name. The name was filtered to remove characters that could inject attributes, but the filter did not handle `/`. Because HTML parsers treat `/` inside a tag as an attribute separator, a tag name such as `img/src/onerror=alert(1)` was rendered as an ` ` element with an `onerror` attribute. The JSX…
items.summary: Astro has an XSS vulnerability via attribute injection in dynamic tag names when parsing `/` characters. Affects developers using Astro. Upgrade astro to 7.4.5 or later.

That check compared paths case-insensitively. On case-sensitive filesystems (such as Linux), a directory whose path differs from the output directory only by letter case is a different directory, but it passed the check. For example, with…
items.summary: The image endpoint in @astrojs/node can read files from case-variant sibling directories on case-sensitive filesystems. Affects developers using Astro with the Node adapter on Linux. No fix yet: watch for a patch.

items.title: Nuxt: Incomplete fix for GHSA-9v7c-q64q-vv33: a leading `//` in the request path bypasses `server/middleware` path checks and server route rules on page routes
items.snippet: Since `4.6.0`, Nuxt parses a request path that starts with `//` as a URL with a host before rendering a page, so `//x/admin` renders the page at `/admin`. Nitro's routing, Nitro's route rules and `server/middleware` see the path as `//x/admin`, so server-side checks keyed on `/admin` do not apply. The fix for [GHSA-9v7c-q64q-vv33](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/security/advisories/GHSA-9v7c-q64q-vv…
items.summary: A leading double-slash in request paths bypasses Nuxt's server middleware and route rules on page routes. Nuxt and Next.js developers are affected. Upgrade @nuxt/nitro-server to 4.6.4 or later.

items.title: dnspython has excessive memory and CPU use

The `from_text()` parser does not check that a WKS record service number is between 0 and 65535 inclusive. It then uses this number to resize the bitmap to accommodate a bit with that offset. This can cause extremely large memory allocations, a…
items.summary: Dnspython is vulnerable to excessive memory and CPU consumption via malformed WKS records in zone files. Python developers parsing DNS zone files are affected. Upgrade dnspython to 2.9.2 or later.

items.summary: NLTK contains a quadratic CPU exhaustion vulnerability in the syllable tokenizer via long runs of vowels, affecting Python applications using NLTK. Upgrade nltk to 3.10.4 or later.

items.title: NLTK: Quadratic CPU exhaustion in TreebankWordTokenizer.span_tokenize via list.pop(0) in quote-restore loop

items.summary: NLTK contains a quadratic CPU exhaustion vulnerability in the word tokenizer via long runs of double-quote characters, affecting Python applications using NLTK. Upgrade nltk to 3.10.4 or later.

items.title: NLTK: Unbounded CPU consumption in SteppingRecursiveDescentParser.parse() with ambiguous or self-embedding grammars

items.summary: NLTK has an unbounded CPU consumption issue in the recursive descent parser with ambiguous grammars, affecting Python applications using NLTK. Upgrade nltk to 3.10.4 or later.

items.summary: NLTK contains a symlink escape vulnerability in corpus readers allowing file reads outside the corpus root, affecting Python apps parsing specific corpora. Upgrade nltk to 3.10.4 or later.

items.title: Tornado: Open redirect via triple-slash redirect paths

This means that the 6.6.0 fix for the RedirectHandler open redirect (CVE-2026-116578, commit cc75ab0e) is incomplete. Tornado 6.6.1 improves the open-redirect detection to handle this case correctly, as well as…
items.summary: Tornado contains an open redirect vulnerability via triple-slash redirect paths due to URL parsing differences, affecting Tornado web apps. Upgrade tornado to 6.6.1 or later.

items.summary: The ag-psd package for Node.js is vulnerable to a denial-of-service memory exhaustion attack when parsing malformed PSD files. Applications processing untrusted PSD uploads are affected. Upgrade ag-psd to 31.0.0 or later.

items.summary: NLTK has a quadratic-time CPU denial of service vulnerability in Tree.chomsky_normal_form right-factor binarization. Python developers using NLTK for parse tree binarization are affected. Upgrade nltk to 3.10.4 or later.
